ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the financial dealings of Minnesota officials and entities, looking for potential connections to the ongoing DOJ investigation.
questions: What financial dealings have Minnesota officials been involved in?
Are there any potential connections to the DOJ investigation?
ideas.insight: As an investigator, I believe that following the money is key to understanding the potential wrongdoing in this case. By examining the financial dealings of Minnesota officials and entities, we may be able to uncover potential connections to the DOJ investigation.
